items.html: And this is the secret of "See now that I, I am He, and there is no god (Elohim) with Me," for this verse is said of Arich Anpin, which is called Ani and Ayin, and is called Hu. This is to indicate that the male, called Ayin, and the female, called Ani, are all one. And it is called Hu, because there is no aspect of a revealed female in it, as above, since it is [entirely] judgments. And for this reason "there is no Elohim with Me," because all the aspects of Elohim that are in Zeir Anpin are, in Arich Anpin, Names of Metzpatz. Remember this.
